editorial:
Imagine a world where the rules are thrown out the window and the ring is basically a war zone. That is exactly what you get here. You have got the legendary Cactus Jack going head-to-head with Sabu in a match that is less about wrestling and more about survival. Meanwhile, the drama is heating up with Raven trying to steal the gold from The Sandman, while Tommy Dreamer is just trying to fight his way through some goofballs to get a piece of Raven. The whole vibe is raw, loud, and completely chaotic, making it feel more like a wild party than a scripted show.

What really hits home is how fast the action moves. You will see things happen that seem impossible, though some of the older camera work can be a bit choppy. The best part is definitely the sheer bravery of the athletes who take huge risks for your entertainment. If you love high-energy fights and don't mind a bit of grit, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The big finish comes down to the brutal Extreme Death Match between Cactus Jack and Sabu. After a ton of weapons and pain, the fight ends in a wild way that leaves both men totally beaten down. It does not have a neat little bow on it, but it proves who the toughest person in the building is. The show wraps up leaving the rivalries between Dreamer and Raven wide open for more fights later on.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school wrestling and hardcore action.
